description: Expected-code record for HEA verification (oev-code-digest/0.1). Binds the code that ran (code_digest), the verification policy it ran under (policy_digest), the dependency versions it ran with, and the environment identity (interpreter, platform, venv/container fingerprint). The verifier compares the attested code_version against this document: code_digest, policy_digest and pinned dependency versions must match exactly; python_version must match exactly; platform/os are recorded and reported as notes (same code may run on another OS); a pinned venv_fingerprint must match exactly.
title: OEVP Code Digest
